outcome_definitions.PASS: The loaded outputs satisfy the supplied qualitative expectation and contain no detected contradiction.
outcome_definitions.PARTIAL: No detected contradictory active assignment, but evidence, scope, dates, relationships or required records remain unresolved.
outcome_definitions.MISMATCH: At least one loaded outcome contradicts the supplied qualitative expectation.
